native.bitrate: Explicit underlying Ethernet PHY link; no independent BACnet/IP 100 Mbit default. Baseline minimum selectable Ethernet link is 10 Mbit, proposal not capability evidence.
native.payload_bytes: Encoded APDU including its header. Actual peer maximum further limits it; NPDU/BVLC/UDP/IP headers and fragmentation are not represented by a universal overhead guess. No arbitrary eight-byte APDU default.
native.mtu_bytes: Explicit IPv4-over-Ethernet baseline MTU 68..1500 bytes, default 1500. Not BACnet APDU capability.
native.duplex: Actual physical Ethernet mode remains unknown; application request/reply does not imply full duplex PHY.
native.bacnet_udp_port: UDP port 47808 literature proposal, configurable unsigned 16-bit nonzero port.
native.bacnet_device_instance: Actual assigned identity 0..4194302; wildcard/unconfigured 4194303 is excluded from assigned instances.
native.bacnet_max_apdu_bytes: Actual accepted APDU length 50..1476 for this IP baseline, unknown. Device property may be 256; six values in the confirmed-request header encoding must not be mistaken for all device property values.
native.bacnet_segmentation: Actual transmit/receive/both/no segmentation from device PICS. Stack compile-time disablement does not define a universal capability.
native.bacnet_apdu_retries: Unsigned integer confirmed-service retries; literature proposal 3, actual no-retry devices may use zero. Generic retry probability is distinct.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_modifiable: Actual boolean device capability, initially unknown, selects the applicable timeout default.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_ms: Unsigned integer ms. Conditional literature defaults 3000 if writable, 60000 otherwise; neither is a universal required operating value. Positive if retries positive. UI condition required before proposing; confirmed operating value preserved.
native.bacnet_segment_timeout_ms: Unsigned integer ms, literature proposal 2000 for segmentation. Positive if retries positive; not application deadline or universal support confirmation.
native.bacnet_broadcast_role: Actual normal/BBMD/foreign-device BVLC role, initially unknown; topology determines applicability.
native.bacnet_foreign_device_ttl_s: Actual registration TTL in seconds, uint16 0..65535; zero is deregistration, not infinite lifetime. No arbitrary vendor lease default.

removed.qos_priority: Generic PCP 3 is not BACnet application priority or an actual Ethernet VLAN configuration.
removed.sync_method: PTP/NTP are not implicit BACnet clock synchronization capabilities.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: Generic percentage cannot establish actual BACnet transaction capacity.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Replaced by actual BACnet confirmed-service retry count; not all BACnet services retry.
removed.retransmission_rate: Probability is not BACnet APDU state-machine retry semantics.
removed.retry_limit: Generic zero replaced by native Number_Of_APDU_Retries literature proposal 3.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: Generic zero replaced by native APDU/segment timeout with conditional defaults.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: Fixed generic 100 Mbit capability is unverified actual router hardware.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: Fixed generic buffer does not describe actual BACnet router storage.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: Fixed generic buffer does not describe actual BACnet router storage.
removed.gateway_maximum_routes: Router routing-table limits are actual hardware configuration.
removed.gateway_maximum_messages_s: Router service throughput requires actual evidence.
removed.vlan_id: Zero is not an actual selected VLAN; VLANs are not implicit in Annex J/IP.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Generic limiter does not implement actual BVLC or device transaction scheduling.
